metadata.title: Synthetic web service estimate
metadata.notes: Entirely synthetic public acceptance example, not a quote. Standard selected; Provider A is a provisional illustration. Build JH and Run JH/month are separate. Provider alternatives must not be added. Forecast FinOps savings require measurement. Kubernetes: Non applicable after suitability review; managed runtime selected. Taxes, discounts, FX and growth excluded; non-cloud OPEX assumed zero. Capacity overloads and delivery overload remain open; this is not an approved production design.

decisions.question: SYN-02 single replica conflicts with SYN-03 two replicas
decisions.rationale: Owner: architecture lead; resolve before design approval. See contradiction.* calculation cells for Build, monthly Run and cloud deltas. Single-replica branch accepts outage; only selected branch enters tasks. All three service scenarios keep the same perimeter.

decisions.question: Reduce forecast non-production idle costs
decisions.rationale: Savings range and selected saving are dynamic finops.* cells. TASK-07 Build and TASK-06 monthly Run. Roll back schedule if wakeup affects testing; meter usage before/after at equal scope. Savings unvalidated; scheduled cost already reflects them.

decisions.question: Managed runtime or Kubernetes platform
decisions.option: Managed runtime and shared managed backend
decisions.rationale: No cluster requirement in this synthetic scope; Kubernetes work Non applicable. Retain application isolation and restore evidence; managed runtime reduces platform ownership, operator monthly Run remains explicit.

decisions.question: Foundation Build exceeds Period 1 capacity
decisions.option: Move dependent Foundation work into another period before approval
decisions.rationale: Dynamic schedule.foundation_overload compares all Foundation Build with collective capacity, not a per-role budget. Delivery lead must confirm collective and individual role availability; subsequent periods cannot start before prerequisites. No approved calendar until overload is resolved.
